title_en: Marika, hey, white girl of the Vardar
en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Traditional urban song; origin unclear. The speaker labels in the last two stanzas are my reading.

lines.en: - Marika, hey, white girl of the Vardar,
white girl of the Vardar, lovely girl of Skopje.

lines.cyr: Што ти се очи Маре крвави,
lines.lat: Što ti se oči Mare krvavi,
lines.en: Why are your eyes bloodshot, Mara,

lines.cyr: што си плакала, што си жалела?
lines.lat: što si plakala, što si žalela?
lines.en: why have you cried, why have you grieved?
Did your mother scold you, Mara,
or did your father beat you?
- Neither did my mother scold me, dear,
nor did my father beat me.
But I have heard, dear, and found out,

lines.cyr: дека со друго либе се жениш.
lines.lat: deka so drugo libe se ženiš.
lines.en: that you are marrying another sweetheart.
That you are marrying, leaving me,
that is why, dear, I have cried.
